inputs.text: extreme wide shot, the subject small in a vast environment. She stands alone on the wet rocks as waves explode behind her. The lead is the only person anywhere in the frame; the rest of the landscape is empty of people. A storm-battered lighthouse on a black rock coast at dusk. The keeper is a woman in a yellow oilskin coat carrying a brass storm lantern. shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses, oval bokeh, horizontal lens flares, teal and orange grade, high contrast.
